cues.text: At which level does the superior mesenteric artery leave the aorta?
The superior mesenteric artery comes off it at the level of L1.
L1 marks an important level: the transpyloric plane of Addison,
a horizontal line halfway between the suprasternal notch and the pubic symphysis.
So remember: the superior mesenteric artery arises at L1, on the transpyloric plane.
